title: GatedV: Self-Gated Values for Transformer Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.02145v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard attention forms query (Q), key (K), and value (V) matrices through learned linear projections of input hidden states. Architectures such as GAU and Mega incorporate nonlinear transformations into attention. In this paper, we propose GatedV, a simple attention variant that applies SiLU only to V before aggregation without introducing additional trainable parameters. We evaluate GatedV against a standard decoder-only Transformer using matched parameter counts, paired initializations, and equal training-token budgets. At 2.33M parameters, GatedV reduces mean held-out perplexity from 59.1 to 57.9 (2.0%), with improvements across all five paired seeds. At 26.16M parameters, following an equal-budget learning-rate search, mean held-out perplexity falls from 20.2 to 19.7 (2.4%), with improvements across all three paired seeds. Small-model ablations show that the tested affine rescaling of values does not fully reproduce GatedV's gains.

translated_title: GatedV：面向Transformer语言模型的自门控值
translated_abstract: 标准的注意力机制通过对输入隐藏状态的学习线性投影来形成查询、键和值矩阵。GAU和Mega等架构在注意力中引入了非线性变换。在本文中，我们提出了GatedV，这是一种简单的注意力变体，它仅在聚合之前对值矩阵V应用SiLU激活函数，而不引入额外的可训练参数。我们在匹配参数量、成对初始化和相等训练token预算的条件下，将GatedV与标准的仅解码器Transformer进行比较评估。在2.33M参数规模下，GatedV将平均留出困惑度从59.1降低到57.9（降低2.0%），在全部五个成对随机种子上均取得改进。在26.16M参数规模下，经过等预算学习率搜索后，平均留出困惑度从20.2降低到19.7（降低2.4%），在全部三个成对随机种子上均取得改进。小模型消融实验表明，所测试的对值进行仿射缩放的方法无法完全复现GatedV带来的增益。
tldr: GatedV是一种无需额外可训练参数的简单注意力变体，通过仅对值矩阵V在聚合前应用SiLU激活函数，即可在多个参数规模下稳定地将语言模型困惑度降低约2.0%至2.4%。
